proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10163 mukhatuṇḍaka explicitly gives Gujarati mɔḍhũ/mɔ̃ḍũ mouth/face. The Bhil moḍu mouth/face forms fit that whole compound family with regional Gujarati transmission possible. Exact survey form moḍu is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
